about: Decoding of the PDF text layer for the table check (structure_marker.py) and the body check (body_check.py). 'families': characters of symbol-encoded fonts (the font's own character codes, the same in every subset of the font); letters of these fonts that are not listed have no decoding and make a table 'not checkable'. 'instances': (cid:N) codes of embedded font subsets; a cid is a glyph index of the subset, so it is decoded only through the table of that embedded instance (subset prefix + family). Every entry was checked on a crop of the glyph by Claude Code on 2026-10-12 (scratch sheets tables2/glyphs/inst*.png); 'evidence' names the paper, page and table of one occurrence. Other characters are taken as they are.
